data.gender_notes: Nayir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'N-W-R', meaning 'to be radiant, to shine, or to be clear'. The name Nayir holds spiritual significance in Islam, symbolizing the inner light and brilliance of a believer. It is mentioned in the Quran as a name for Prophet Moses (as). The name Nayir carries the meaning “Radiant, Brilliant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nayir usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, brilliant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
